bars.label: deterministic oracle pass count on the 240-row M6 reasoning and coding panel
bars.note: current (12/240, 5.00%) is the maximum score across 8 full seeded draws of the prompt-only M6CountTableBaseline (scores 10..=12/240 with +-1 rows noise; family-conditioned modal ceiling is 10/240 on the 10 unsatisfiable feasibility rows, and numeric-only count table scores 1..=3/240). Proposed target 168/240 (70.0%, +156 rows above the count-table ceiling, 156x the +-1 row noise band) is submitted via decision card #2028 comment 6344266280 for owner confirmation under CHARTER section 5.2; frozen stays false until the owner registers the bar and a non-author FIT review lands.

bars.label: unseen multi-step compositions (3-step register and versioned-memory arithmetic)
bars.note: requires exact canonical integer match on both intermediate addressed-memory/register state (INT) and final output (OUT) across 40 3-step register chains and 40 versioned-slot chains with >= 2 decimal carries, >= 1 decimal borrow on the subtracted operand, zero target-numeral leakage in the prompt, and zero overlap with the 18 pairs and 30 triples in m6_exact_arithmetic.rs; count-table baseline scores 0/80 across all 8 seeds.

bars.label: altered constraints (non-decimal radix, rebound precedence, modular cap, and balanced feasibility abstention)
bars.note: 70 satisfiable rows (20 non-decimal radix in {7,8,9,11,12,13,16}, 20 rebound [+] over [*] precedence, 20 modular forbidden-residue step cap balanced 10 taken / 10 not-taken, and 10 satisfiable feasibility rows) plus 10 unsatisfiable feasibility rows requiring ABSTAIN:UNSATISFIABLE with identical prompt wording so surface keyword rules score only 10/20 on feasibility; reaching 56/80 requires at least 46/70 on satisfiable altered-constraint rows in addition to abstention discrimination.

bars.label: executable coding tasks (4-vector 256-step sandbox and rustc --test oracle)
bars.note: 80 parameterized integer algorithm tasks (20 AffinelyScaledClampLoop, 20 RadixDigitWeightedSum, 20 BoundedRingStep, 20 PiecewiseParityRecurrence), each graded on 4 held-out (input, expected_output) test vectors in the 256-step zero-I/O SandboxProgram machine and standalone rustc --test verifier; count-table baseline scores 0/80 across all 8 seeds.
